sourceRefs.locator: Book II.37, final sentence, and II.38. Gifts to Saint Martin, the documents from Anastasius, royal dress and public distribution of gold and silver in Tours.
pp. 79–83 and 105–109. Account of the 508 visit in Histories II.37–38, ceremonial clothing, largesse and competing readings of the emperor’s honours.

summary.de: Oströmischer Kaiser. Gregor von Tours berichtet, er habe Chlodwig nach dessen Sieg Urkunden über das Konsulat geschickt.
summary.en: Eastern Roman emperor who, in Gregory’s account, sent Clovis documents concerning the consulship after the victory.
